title: Self-Pay Visit Package — Collecting a Past-Due Installment
content:
**Past-due installments on a Self-Pay Visit Package.** An installment of a Self-Pay Visit Package paid in installments whose due date has passed and that has no installment payment in the package history is collected on the call as a past-due installment, and the payment credits the tier's visits included divided by its number of installments.

**Business effect.** Once collected, the package history shows the installment payment and, tied to it, the visit credit for that installment; the package's amount paid rises by the amount collected and its visits remaining rise by the visits credited.

## Situation of use and capability

The tool records one installment payment against a self-pay visit package that is paid in installments and, in the same transaction, adds the stated number of visits to the package's available visits.

## How it is invoked

`draft_package_installment_97c9f1d1` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `package_id` | the visit package reference number of the package the installment belongs to, read from the visit package lookup | identifier |
| `installment_number` | the ordinal of the installment being collected | non-negative integer |
| `amount` | the money collected for this installment, in USD | positive amount, 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `payment_method` | how the patient pays this installment | exactly one of the values below |
| `visits_credited` | the package visits this installment adds | non-negative integer (visits) |

Values of `payment_method`:

- `card` — a credit or debit card, including the card kept on file for automatic drafts;
- `cash` — cash handed over at the clinic front desk;
- `check` — a paper check;
- `hsa_fsa_card` — a health savings or flexible spending account card.

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `status` "installment_collected", together with `package_id` (the package reference number), `payment_event_id` (reference number of the installment payment entry), `credit_event_id` (reference number of the visit credit entry), `installment_number`, `amount` (USD, 2 decimals), `visits_credited`, `amount_paid_total` (the package's new amount paid, USD, 2 decimals) and `visits_remaining` (the package's new available visits).

*Hypothetical illustration of the contract:* a call naming an installment number of 2, an amount of 412.00, the method `card` and 6 visits credited returns "installment_collected" with the amount paid and visits remaining of the package each raised by those figures.
